summary.text: Jake Young is the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Roman Kozak.

A fifth-generation Chippewa Township native who now lives in New Brighton, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he works for the YMCA of Greater Pittsburgh and is running on jobs, property tax reform and consumer protection.

paragraphs.text: Jake Young attended Blackhawk Tech for high school and later the University of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania State University and Denison University, and his career experience includes working as an administrator.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his work has included steelwork, postal work, sales, political campaigns, and service as Membership and Development Director for the Greater Pittsburgh Chamber of Commerce.
He said he now works for the YMCA of Greater Pittsburgh and was the primary caregiver for both of his parents, who had Alzheimer's.
Young's survey responses list jobs and economic security, reducing reliance on property taxes with a fairer school funding system, and consumer protection and cost of living as his key messages.
He said he supports a national health service modeled on the Veterans Affairs system and wants large developments, including data centers, to pay their own infrastructure costs.
